blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Modern vision-language models (VLMs) have shown promising results in long-video understanding due to the rich semantic information they can capture. However, most methods focus on coarse captioning of extracted image frames that are computationally inefficient and require models with large context windows. While past work has explored efficient methods through multimodal retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), they rely on lossy embeddings that lose temporal context and fine-grained detail. Few works to date have investigated how VLM-based query-relevant information retrieval can be optimized. We introduce LazySloth, an efficient tree-based search method that speeds up video comprehension and retrieval tasks 2.9-8.3x (compared to existing agentic methods) through bounded captioning of portions of the video considered irrelevant by a VLM of the video. Compared to contemporary specialized video-understanding VLMs and RAG-based methods, LazySloth achieved similar or better final task accuracy across two recent open-source base VLMs–Gemma 4 31B and Qwen3.6 27B–across four benchmarks. LazySloth reduced the gap between the base open-source model and a closed-source model, GPT-4o. Ablations showed that replacing VLM scene understanding with CLIP-based retrieval cost 8.8–19.9% in accuracy, while lazy tree construction matches eager construction at a fraction of the captioning cost. With LazySloth, we demonstrate the possibility of faster long-video comprehension without substantial loss in performance.
blocks.zh: 现代视觉语言模型(VLMs)由于能够捕捉到丰富的语义信息,在长视频理解上显示出有希望的结果. 然而,大多数方法都注重对提取的图像框架粗糙的字幕,这些图像框架在计算上效率低下,需要具有大上下文窗口的模型. 虽然过去的工作通过多模式检索强化生成(RAG)探索了高效方法,但它们依赖于失去时间背景和精细细节的失落嵌入。 迄今为止,很少有工作研究如何优化基于VLM的查询相关信息检索。 LazySloth是一种基于树的高效搜索方法,通过对视频VLM认为无关的部分视频的限定字幕,加快视频理解和检索任务2.9-8.3x(与现有代理方法相比)。 与当代专业视频理解的VLM和基于RAG的方法相比,LazySloth在最近两个开源基数VLMs–Gemma 4 31B和Quen3.6 27B的四大基准中实现了类似或更好的最终任务精度. LazySloth缩小了基础开源模型和闭源模型GPT-4o之间的差距. 校对显示,用基于 CLIP 的检索方式取代 VLM 场景理解 准确性为8.8–19.9%,而懒惰的树构筑则与急切的构造相匹配,成本仅为标题成本的一小部分. 与LazySloth一起,我们展示了更快的长视频理解而不会在性能上出现重大损失的可能性.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The frontier for video understanding has moved from short, curated clips ( Mangalam, Akshkulakov, and Malik 2023 ) to long-form content such as feature-length films, hour-long lectures, and egocentric recordings 1 1 1 https://ego4d-data.org/ ( Hong et al. 2025 ; Shu et al. 2025 ) , to weeks-long videos spanning multiple topics ( Rege et al. 2026 ) . Existing work on answering a question from such content focused on explicit localization (finding the handful of seconds that matter) ( Zuo et al. 2025 ) and comprehension (reasoning over what happens in the localized frames) ( Yeo et al. 2026 ) . Modern VLMs are exceptionally good at processing long-context inputs across modalities ( Wang et al. 2025c ) , improving over contrastive methods that showed little success ( Bagad, Tapaswi, and Snoek 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 视频理解的前沿已经从短片、剪辑片段(Mangalam、Akshkulakov和Malik 2023)发展到长片面内容,如短片、一小时讲座和以自我为中心的录制片段。 (洪等编). 2025年;Shu等人,2025年),到周长的视频,涉及多个话题(Rege等人,2026年). 现有关于回答这类内容中的问题的工作侧重于明确本地化(调查那几秒钟的问题)(Zuo等人,2025年)和理解(解释本地化框架发生的情况)(Yeo等人,2026年)。 现代 VLM非常擅长处理跨模式的长文本输入(Wang等人,2025年c),改进了对比性方法,没有表现出什么成功(Bagad、Tapaswi和Snoek 2023).

blocks.en: Figure 1: Overview of how LazySloth bounds captioning. Each level captures more fine-grained information, with the parent root representing all of the video. Grayed-out nodes are never visited, which reduces the total time to navigate through the hierarchical tree.
blocks.zh: 图1:LazySloth如何限制标题的概述。 每个关卡都捕捉到更多的精细信息,由母根代表所有视频. 灰色出节点从不访问,这减少了通过阶梯树导航的总时间.

blocks.en: However, the semantic expertise of VLMs comes at a tradeoff, and two main paradigms of VLM-based video understanding have emerged. The first places sampled frames directly into the model’s context and asks for an answer in one shot ( Shen et al. 2025 ; Shu et al. 2025 ) . This is bounded by the context window and the quadratic cost of attention: an hour of video sampled at even one frame per second (FPS) yields thousands of frames and hundreds of thousands of visual tokens, forcing frame budgets so aggressive that the evidence needed to answer is often not sampled. To combat this, a second paradigm has emerged that converts the video into text: a VLM captions every frame or every fixed-length segment, and an LLM then reasons over the resulting corpus ( Zuo et al. 2025 ; Yeo et al. 2026 ; Wang et al. 2025b ) . This circumvents the context limit and yields an easily searchable artifact. However, this requires one VLM call per unit of video, so the cost scales linearly with duration regardless of the question asked . A question about a five-second event still requires captioning the other fifty-nine minutes. Since the VLM call is much more expensive than any other component of the system, this wasted captioning is the bottleneck.
blocks.zh: 然而,VLMs的语义学专业知识在取舍上出现,基于VLM的视频理解的两大范式已经出现. 最早将抽样的帧直接放在模型的上下文中,要求在一个镜头中给出答案(Shen等人. 2025; Shu et al. 2025 ). 这受上下文窗口和四重关注成本的束缚:一个小时的视频取样,每秒甚至一个帧(FPS),产生数千帧和数十万个视觉符号,迫使帧预算如此激烈,以至于往往没有取样回答所需的证据. 为了解决这一问题,出现了将视频转换成文本的第二个范式:一个VLM字幕,每帧或每段固定长度,以及一个LLM,然后是由此而产生的原因(Zuo等人)。 2025; Yeo等人著. 2026; 王等编. 2025b. (中文(简体) ). 这规避了上下文的限制,并产生了易于搜索的文物. 因此成本的线性尺度, 关于五秒事件的问题 还需要另外59分钟的字幕 由于VLM呼叫比系统任何其他组件都要昂贵得多,因此这种浪费的字幕就是瓶颈.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Overview of the LazySloth pipeline. (A) Corpus creation, which produced an ordered list of frames after applying optional uniform frame sampling to the input video. (B) Hierarchical frame bunching, which initialized the first few levels of the search tree. (C) Lazy generation of tree nodes by the captioner VLM C C . (D) Agentic Direct Corpus Interaction (DCI), where the search VLM S S explored the tree with backtracking to traverse alternative branches. (E) Final answer prediction by the reasoner VLM (R), conditioned on the textual evidence and representative frames collected during the search.

Multimodal retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) addresses precisely this issue by retrieving candidate segments with contrastive image-text encoders before invoking a
VLM ( Radford et al. 2021 ; Most et al. 2025 ) . Retrieval is cheap, but the representation is lossy ( Yu et al. 2025 ; Lumer et al. 2026 ) as the contrastive encoder compresses a frame or even a pool of frames into a single vector. This discards temporal, motion, and fine-grained detail.
blocks.zh:
多式联运检索增强生成(RAG)通过检索带有对比性图像文本编码器的候选部分,准确解决这一问题。
VLM (拉德福德等人). 2021; Most et al. 2025 ). 检索是便宜的,但表示方式是失去的(Yu等人,2025年;Lumer等人,2026年),因为对比编码器将一个帧甚至一个帧集合压缩成一个单一的矢量. 这丢弃了时间、运动和细微的细节。

blocks.en: Efficient methods retrieve with lossy embeddings while accurate methods caption extensively with VLMs. Few works have asked how VLM-based retrieval itself should be optimized. To address this, we introduce LazySloth (Figure 2 ), a tree-based search method that generates captions lazily. LazySloth summarizes the video as a top-down tree that is never fully instantiated. We show a LLM a root summary of the whole clip and a handful of coarse branch summaries, from which it descends into the branch it determines is most relevant to the question. Only that branch’s children are captioned, and we repeat this descent until an interval is small enough to expand into per-frame detail. Finally, a multimodal reasoner answers from the evidence surfaced along the path together with the key frames the search resolved to. This bounds the captioning cost to the depth of the descent rather than the length of the video, and grows logarithmically where prior methods grow linearly.
blocks.zh: 高效的方法用丢失的嵌入进行检索,而精确的方法则用 VLM 广泛进行字幕. 很少有作品询问如何优化基于VLM的检索本身. 为了解决这个问题,我们引入了LazySloth(图2),这是一种基于树的搜索方法,可以生成懒散的字幕. LazySloth将视频总结为一棵从未完全即时化的自上而下的树. 我们向LLM展示整个片段的根部摘要和少数粗细的分支摘要,从这些摘要中,它降入它决定的分支与问题最为相关. 只有这个分支的孩子有标题,我们重复这个顺序,直到一个间隔足够小,可以扩展成每个框架的细节。 最后,从证据中找到的多式理由解答与搜索确定的关键框架一起出现。 这将标题成本限制在下降深度,而不是视频长度上,并在以往方法呈线性增长的地方增长对数。

blocks.en: Across four long-video benchmarks and two recent open-source VLMs, LazySloth was 2.9–8.3 × \times faster than existing agentic methods while matching or exceeding both specialized long-video VLMs and RAG-based pipelines in accuracy. It also narrowed the accuracy gap between the tested open-source models and a closed-source model, GPT-4o.
blocks.zh: LazySloth在四个长视频基准和两个最近开源的VLM中,比现有的代理方法快2.9–8.3×时,同时精确地匹配或超过专门的长视频VLM和基于RAG的管道。 这也缩小了被测试的开源模型和闭源模型GPT-4o之间的精度差距.

blocks.en: Our contributions are: 1. LazySloth , a lazy hierarchical search method that bounds VLM captioning to the branch the search actually explores, making captioning cost logarithmic rather than linear in video length. 2. Evidence that VLM-based retrieval on frame bunches (that captures temporal change unlike individual frames) can be made efficient without falling back on lossy embeddings. 3. An evaluation across four long-video benchmarks and two open base VLMs against specialized video VLMs, RAG pipelines, and agentic baselines, showing 2.9–8.3 × \times speedups at comparable or better accuracy. 4. Ablations that separately isolate the contribution of the hierarchy, of its laziness, and of VLM-based versus embedding-based scene understanding.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是: 1. LazySloth,一种懒惰的分级搜索方法,它将VLM字幕限制在搜索实际探索的分支,使字幕的成本对数而不是视频长度的线性. 2. 有证据表明,基于帧组合的VLM检索(捕捉时间变化与单个帧不同)能够高效,而不会回落到丢失的嵌入物上。 3. 对四个长视频基准和两个开放基VLM进行针对专用视频VLM、RAG管道和代理基线的评价,显示2.9–8.3×以可比或更好的精确度速度。 4. 将等级、其懒惰性和基于VLM与嵌入式场景理解的贡献分别隔离开来。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Vision–Language Models (VLMs)
blocks.zh: 2.1 远景-语言模型

blocks.en: General Purpose Video VLMs
blocks.zh: 通用视频VLM

blocks.en: Open VLM series such as VideoLLaMA 2 2 2 https://github.com/damo-nlp-sg/videollama3 , Qwen-VL 3 3 3 https://github.com/qwenlm/qwen3-vl , InternVL 4 4 4 https://github.com/OpenGVLab/InternVL , LLaVA-Video/OneVision 5 5 5 https://github.com/EvolvingLMMs-Lab/LLaVA-OneVision-2 , Gemma 6 6 6 https://deepmind.google/models/gemma/gemma-4/ , and GLM 7 7 7 https://z.ai/blog/glm-5 are extensively used for building agentic video-understanding systems. These VLMs, however, ingest video data as sequences of uniformly sampled frames within their context length budgets, and rely on aggressive truncation or down-sampling for longer and high-resolution videos. Although this allows for graceful scaling, smaller open models degrade after roughly 30 frames ( Wu et al. 2024 ) , consistent with the lost-in-the-middle effect ( Liu et al. 2024 ) . Using context-as-memory did not provide usable memory (see experiments in Appendix B ), which motivated our search for efficient retrieval systems that support hundreds of frames.
blocks.zh: 开放VLM系列,如VideoLaMA 2 2 2 https://github.com/damo-nlp-sg/videolama3,Quen-VL 3 3 https://github.com/qwenlm/qwen3-vl,InternVL 4 4 https://github.com/OpenGVLab/InternVL,LLaVA-Video/One Visiion 5 5 https://github.com/EvolvingLMms-Lab/LAVA-OneVision-2,Gemma 6 6 https://deepmind.google/models/gemma-4/,以及GLM 7 7 https://z.ai/blog/glm-5 广泛用于建立视频理解系统。 然而,这些VLM在其上下文长度预算范围内将视频数据作为统一取样框架的序列进行摄入,并依靠积极的截断或下采样来进行较长和高分辨率的视频. 虽然这允许优雅的缩放,但较小的开放型号在大约30帧后退化(Wu等人,2024年),与中度失落效应(Liu等人,2024年)一致. 使用现成内存并不能提供可用的内存(见附录B中的实验),这促使我们寻找支持数百帧的高效检索系统。

blocks.en: Specialized VLMs for Long Videos
blocks.zh: 长视频专用VLM

blocks.en: Specialized VLMs have also emerged to address the unique problems of long video understanding. VideoLLaMA 3 ( Zhang et al. 2025 ) , a well-known model in this space, utilizes high-quality vision-centric image-text datasets in its training corpus and achieved 2-3% gains on benchmarks like Video Multi-Modal Evaluation (Video-MME) ( Fu et al. 2025 ) and Multi-task Long Video Understanding (MLVU) ( Zhou et al. 2025 ) . Other notable models include VideoChat-Flash ( Li et al. 2025a ) and video-SALMONN 2+ ( Tang et al. 2026 ) , which employs model architecture and training data innovations to improve video understanding. More recently, VideoChat-R1 ( Li et al. 2025b ) integrates spatio-temporal specific rewards with reinforcement learning to improve temporal grounding of VLMs. The core limitations of frame sampling and utilizing memory as context, however, remain (Section 4 ).
blocks.zh: 专门的VLM也出现,以解决长视频理解的独特问题. 视频LALMA 3(Zhang等人,2025年)是这一空间中一个知名的模型,在其培训教材中使用了高质量的以视觉为中心的图像文本数据集,并在视频多模式评价(Video-MME)(Fu等人,2025年)和多任务长视频理解(MLVU)(周等人,2025年)等基准上取得了2%-3%的收获. 其他显著模式包括VideoChat-Flash(Li等人,2025a)和Video-SALMONN 2+ (Tang et al. 2026),采用模型架构和培训数据创新,提高视频理解度. 最近,VideoChat-R1(Li等人,2025年b)将时空特定奖励与强化学习相结合,以改善对VLM的时间定位。 然而,框架取样和利用内存作为背景的核心局限性依然存在(第4节)。

blocks.en: 2.2 Long Video-Understanding Datasets and Benchmarks
blocks.zh: 2.2 长期视频理解数据集和基准

blocks.en: Several high-quality long video-understanding datasets and benchmarks have been released to evaluate foundation model capabilities and train small-scale specialized VLMs. LongVideoBench ( Wu et al. 2024 ) and Video-MME ( Fu et al. 2025 ) are widely used for model evaluation in a multiple-choice question (MCQ) format, with videos sourced from web platforms such as YouTube 8 8 8 https://www.youtube.com . More recently, evaluation has focused on extremely long (weeks-long, rather than hours) video understanding in VLMs ( Wang et al. 2025a ) . The Ego4D and EgoLife 9 9 9 https://ego4d-data.org/ , https://egolife-ai.github.io/ corpora have also been utilized for testing long-format egocentric content, with datasets such as EgoSchema ( Mangalam, Akshkulakov, and Malik 2023 ) and EgoMemReason ( Wang et al. 2026 ) testing short and week-long comprehension, respectively, in MCQ format. Benchmarks studied in this paper are summarized in Table 1 .
blocks.zh: 发布了若干高质量的长视频理解数据集和基准,以评价基础模型能力并培训小规模的专门甚高频。 Long Video Bench (Wu et al. 2024)和Video-MME (Fu et al. 2025)被广泛用于多选题(MCQ)格式的模型评价,视频来源于YouTube 8 8 8 https://www.youtube.com等网络平台. 最近,评价的重点是在VLMs(Wang等人,2025年a)中极其长的(周长,而不是小时)视频理解。 Ego4D和EgoLife 9 9 9 https://ego4d-data.org/,https://egolife-ai.github.io/corpora也被用于测试长格式的自我中心内容,数据集如EgoSchema(Mangalam、Akshkulakov和Malik 2023)和EgoMemReason(Wang等人,2026)分别以MCQ格式测试短时间和一周的理解。 本文件研究的基准摘要见表1。

blocks.en: 2.3 Methods for Long Video-Understanding
blocks.zh: 2.3 长期视频了解的方法

blocks.en: RAG-Based Methods
blocks.zh: 基于RAG的方法

blocks.en: Multimodal retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) has been explored for long-video understanding. Yeo et al. (2026) studied RAG-based methods such as the text-based LightRAG ( Guo et al. 2025 ) and HippoRAG ( Gutierrez et al. 2024 ) , and the multimodal Video-RAG ( Luo et al. 2025 ) . Our method resolves the concern of relying on lossy multimodal embeddings by utilizing semantic LLM-based scene understanding (Section 4.3 ).
blocks.zh: 为了解长视频,探索了多模式检索增强生成(RAG)。 叶等. (2026年)研究了基于RAG的方法,如基于文本的LightRAG(Guo等人,2025年)和HippoRAG(Gutierrez等人,2024年),以及多式联运视频-RAG(Luo等人,2025年). 我们的方法解决了通过使用基于语义的LLM(LLM)的场景理解(第4.3节)而依赖失落的多式联运嵌入方式的问题。

blocks.en: Agentic methods
blocks.zh: 代理方法

blocks.en: Several agentic methods have been proposed in the literature to improve VLM-based long video comprehension techniques. Some notable recent work includes VideoLucy ( Zuo et al. 2025 ) , which evaluated the effectiveness of coarse-to-fine-grained memory-based retrieval. Other related work has evaluated the effect of storing specialized memory banks for episodic, semantic, and visual data separately ( Yeo et al. 2026 ) , while Wang et al. (2025b) uses self-reflection-based iterative searching with VLMs. However, these works did not evaluate how VLM-based long video search can be optimized without significant performance reductions.
blocks.zh: 在文献中提出了几种代理方法,以改进基于VLM的长视频理解技术。 最近一些值得注意的作品包括VideoLucy(Zuo等人,2025年),该作品评价了粗到细的内存检索的有效性. 其他相关工作评价了将专门的内存库存储单独用于偶发,语义,和视觉数据的效果(Yeo等人,2026年),而Wang等人(2025年b)则使用基于自我反射的迭代搜索,使用VLMs. 然而,这些作品并没有评价如何在没有显著性能降低的情况下优化基于VLM的长视频搜索.

blocks.en: 3 LazySloth
blocks.zh: 3 懒惰

blocks.en: Our proposed method, LazySloth (Figure 2 ), answers a query Q Q over a long video without captioning every frame. It utilizes three VLMs: a captioner model, C C , that builds a top-down caption tree lazily, a searcher VLM S S , and a reasoner VLM R R . S S repeatedly navigates into a branch that it determines to be most relevant. R R finally answers the query given the selected caption corpus (temporal context) plus the key frames of the region the search narrowed to (visual evidence).
blocks.zh: 我们提议的方法LazySloth(图2)通过长视频回答一个查询QQ,而不给每个帧字幕. 它使用三个VLM:一个标题模型C C,它构建自上而下的标题树懒散,一个搜索器VLM S S,以及一个解释器VLM R R. S 反复导航到它认定最相关的分支. R R 最终根据选定的标题( 时间背景) 以及搜索范围缩小到( 视觉证据) 的区域关键框架回答询问 。

blocks.en: After decoding the video clip for frame extraction, we get an ordered frame list F = ⟨ f 1 ​ … ​ f N ⟩ F=\langle f_{1}\ldots f_{N}\rangle (timestamps are provided in context). The top-down lazy tree is then initiated, spanning all N N frames, which we caption with C C on ≤ m b \leq m_{b} uniformly sampled representative frames. At every step, the root is split into k k (branch factor) roughly equal children, each of which represents a contiguous spans of the video. Each span is captioned the same way with C C . blocks.en: We evaluated the proposed framework on four established MCQ video question-answering benchmarks with well-maintained leader boards, spanning movie clips, general web videos, long-form videos, and egocentric videos, following the discussion in Section 2.2 : Video-MME ( Fu et al. 2025 ) , LongVideoBench ( Wu et al. 2024 ) , LVBench ( Wang et al. 2025a ) , and EgoSchema ( Mangalam, Akshkulakov, and Malik 2023 ) . Table 1 summarizes each dataset’s statistics. For all of these benchmarks, we conducted a full run and reported task accuracy as an exact match of the LLM’s output MCQ label to the ground truth.
blocks.zh: 我们根据第2.2节的讨论,评价了关于四个既定的MCQ视频问答基准的拟议框架,这些基准保持良好的领导板,包括电影剪辑、一般网络视频、长式视频和以自我为中心的视频:Video-MME(Fu等人,2025年),LongVideo Bench(Wu等人,2024年),LV Bench(Wang等人,2025年)和EgoSchema(Mangalam、Akshkulakov和Malik,2023年)。 表1汇总了每个数据集的统计数据。 对于所有这些基准,我们进行了全面的运行并报告了任务准确性,作为LLM输出MCQ标签与地面真相的精确匹配.

blocks.en: 3.2 Baselines
blocks.zh: 3.2 基线

blocks.en: For each dataset, we first quantified random baseline performance as 1 / N 1/N , where N N is the number of MCQ options for Video-MME, LongVideoBench, LVBench, and EgoSchema.
blocks.zh: 对于每个数据集,我们首先量化随机基准性能为1 / N 1/N ,其中N N是Video-MME,LongVideo Bench,LV Bench,和EgoSchema的MCQ选项数.

blocks.en: We compared LazySloth to multiple classes of methods starting with general video-understanding models, specifically Qwen3.6 27B 10 10 10 https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3.6-27B and Gemma 4 31B 11 11 11 https://huggingface.co/google/gemma-4-31B-it , using at most 64 frames sampled from each video to stay within their context windows ( Yin et al. 2024 ; Fu et al. 2025 ; Doorenbos, Spurio, and Gall 2025 ) . Next, specialized video-understanding models such as VideoChat-R1 ( Li et al. 2025b ) and VideoLLaMA 3 ( Zhang et al. 2025 ) were tested. To understand how our method compares to RAG-based methods, we compared it against the text-based LightRAG ( Guo et al. 2025 ) followed by the multimodal Video-RAG ( Luo et al. 2025 ) . Finally, among modern agentic baselines, we included VideoLucy ( Zuo et al. 2025 ) and WorldMM ( Yeo et al. 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们把LazySloth比作从一般视频理解模型开始的多类方法,具体来说是Quen3.6 27B 10 10 https://huggingface.co/Quen/Quen3.6-27B和Gemma 4 31B 11 11 https://huggingface.co/google/gemma-4-31B-it,最多使用从每段视频中抽取的64帧,以停留在上下文窗口内(Yin等人)。 2024; Fu et al. 2025; Doorenbos, Spurio, and Gall 2025 ). 随后,对VideoChat-R1(Li等人2025b)和VideoLLAMA 3(Zhang等人2025)等专业视频理解模型进行了测试. 为了了解我们的方法如何与基于RAG的方法相比,我们把它与基于文本的LightRAG(Guo等人,2025年)和随后的多式联运视频-RAG(Luo等人,2025年)相比较。 最后,在现代代理基准中,我们包括VideoLucy(Zuo等人,2025年)和WorldMM(Yeo等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: 3.3 Ablations
blocks.zh: 3.3 违约

blocks.en: We designed two ablations to investigate (a) the behavior of lazy tree generation, (b) the impact of the tree data structure, and (c) the effectiveness of using VLMs instead of multimodal embeddings. We replaced the searcher VLM S S with embedding-based retrieval by scoring the tree nodes using Contrastive Language–Image Pretraining Score (CLIPScore) ( Hessel et al. 2021 ) . This enabled greedy best-first search (Greedy BFS) over the tree.
blocks.zh: 我们设计了两幅浮雕,以调查(a) 懒惰树木生成的行为,(b) 树木数据结构的影响,(c) 使用VLM而不是多模式嵌入的有效性。 我们用嵌入式检索取代了搜索器VLM S S,方法是使用Contrastic Language-Image Pretraining Score(CLIPScore)对树节点进行评分(Hessel等人,2021年)。 这使得贪婪的第一搜索(Greedy BFS)能够超越树.

blocks.en: The searcher S S first navigated that tree lazily with DRILL and EXPAND , and generated its answer using the collected evidence. This allowed us to illustrate the impact of VLM-based scene understanding . Next, we ablated the effect of lazy tree generation by eagerly constructing the full hierarchy with CLIPScore-based nodes. The searcher S S then received the full tree as context while collecting evidence. We kept all other components, including the backtracking from the main method, intact, ablating the lazy, on-demand (top-down, implicitly pruned) tree construction of LazySloth. These comparisons allowed us to illustrate the efficiency gains of Algorithm 1 over naive brute-forced methods.
blocks.zh: 搜索者S首先用 DRILL 和 EXPAND 懒散地导航了这棵树,并利用收集到的证据生成了它的答案. 这让我们可以说明基于VLM的场景理解的影响。 接下来,我们急切地用CLIPScore的节点构建了完整的等级体系,从而缓解了懒惰树生成的影响. 搜索者S S随后在收集证据时作为上下文接收了整棵树. 我们保留了所有其他部件, 包括从主方法的回转, 完好无损, 这些比较使我们能够说明算法1比天真野蛮强迫方法的效率提高。

blocks.en: 3.4 Experimental Setup & Models Tested

blocks.en: All experiments on existing agentic methods and LazySloth were repeated on two base searcher S S and reasoner R R VLMs (Qwen3.6 27B and Gemma 4 31B). We ran Qwen 3.6 and Gemma 4’s compiled GGML Universal File (GGUF) locally through LM Studio 12 12 12 https://lmstudio.ai/ . The captioner model C C was set to Nvidia’s Nemotron 3 Nano Omni 30B for an equitable comparison of each method’s merit (which was chosen based on caption quality experiments outlined in Appendix C ). We loaded Nemotron 3’s compiled GGUF locally through LM Studio. All experiments were run on four Nvidia H100 80 GB, one RTX Pro 6000 96 GB, and two RTX 3090 24 GB GPUs. All videos were sampled at 1 FPS and models initialized with a context window of 79,104 tokens to fit on our available hardware.

blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en:
Table 2 shows the accuracy of LazySloth compared to existing models and methods. Our method outperformed specialized models and retrieval-based methods. On Qwen 3.6 27B, LazySloth exceeded the strongest specialized video-understanding model on every benchmark: by 5.2 points over VideoLLaMA 3 on Video-MME, 2.2 on LongVideoBench, 1.5 over Time-R1 on
LVBench, and 13.3 over VideoLLaMA 3 on EgoSchema. Importantly, these gains were realized with a general-purpose base model (i.e., backbone), and no video-specific training. LazySloth also outperformed the best RAG-based baseline (Video-RAG 7B) by at least 6.0 points on the two benchmarks where their numbers were available, which was consistent with our claim that embedding retrieval discards fine-grained detail required for sophisticated video understanding.
blocks.zh:
表2显示与现有模型和方法相比LazySloth的准确性. 我们的方法优于专业模型和基于检索的方法。 在Quen 3.6 27B上,LazySloth超越了每个基准上最强的专业视频理解模式:在Video-MME上比VideoLLaMA 3高5.2分,在LongVideo Bench上比2.2分,在Time-R1上比1.5分.
LV奔驰,和13.3 在VideoLLaMA 3在EgoSchema。 重要的是,这些成果是通过通用基础模式(即骨干)实现的,没有进行视频专用培训。 LazySloth还比基于RAG的最佳基准(Video-RAG 7B)在有其数字的两个基准上至少高出6.0分,这与我们的说法是一致的,即嵌入检索会丢弃精密的视频理解所需的精细细节.

blocks.en: Among other agentic methods such as VideoLucy, using Qwen3.6 27B as the backbone, we saw that LazySloth improved over VideoLucy by 27.1, 9.3, 3.7, and 22.8 points, and over WorldMM by 9.6 points on LVBench. The margin over direct inference was 11.4–35.5 points. We note that VideoLucy underperformed compared to direct inference on Video-MME with the same backbone (34.3% vs. 45.7%), whereas LazySloth improved on it by 15.7%.
blocks.zh: 在VideoLucy等代理方法中,以Quen3.6 27B为骨干,我们看到LazySloth比VideoLucy改进了27.1、9.3、3.7和22.8分,比LV Bench的WorldMM改进了9.6分. 直接推论的比值为11.4-35.5分。 我们注意到,VideoLucy的性能低于同一骨干网基的Video-MME的直接推论(34.3%对45.7%),而LazySloth的改进率为15.7%。

blocks.en: To better understand the gains realized with LazySloth, we first compared the median wall clock time across our method and the two agentic baselines, VideoLucy and WorldMM. As a control, we included the brute-forced eager bottom-up tree (Section 3.3 ). For these tests, we focused only on the LVBench dataset as it contained the longest videos in our test set (Table 1 ). Figure 3 shows that our method was the fastest, with median time to answer a single LVBench query at 194 seconds (secs) compared to 611 secs on VideoLucy, and 1,139 secs on WorldMM. On the longest videos (140 minutes long), our method was 3 × \times faster than VideoLucy and 7.7 × \times faster than WorldMM. The gap with the brute-forced eager bottom-up tree remained disproportionately high at 287 × \times slower than LazySloth. Direct inference, which feeds 64 frames into the VLM’s memory, stayed constant at 57 secs, and resulted in notably lower task accuracies. Additional discussion about efficiency can be found in Appendix D .
blocks.zh: 为了更好地了解LazySloth公司取得的成果,我们首先比较了我们方法的中位时钟时间以及VideoLucy和WorldMM两个代理基线。 作为控制,我们包括了野蛮强迫的渴望自下而上的树(第3.3节)。 对于这些测试,我们只关注LV Bench数据集,因为它包含了我们测试集中最长的视频(表1). 图3显示,我们的方法最快,以194秒(秒)的中位时间回答一个LV Bench查询,而VideoLucy上为611秒,WorldMM上为1,139秒。 在最长的视频(140分钟长)中,我们的方法比VideoLucy快3×时,比WorldMM快7.7×时. 与凶猛的贪婪自下而上树的差距仍然不成比例地大,比LazySloth慢了287xxxxx时间。 直接推论将64帧反馈到VLM的内存中,在57秒时保持不变,并导致明显较低的任务进度。 关于效率的其他讨论载于附录D。

blocks.en: Next, we decomposed each method into three categories: time spent captioning, time spent reasoning, and overhead (e.g., video decode, I/O, etc). Figure 4 shows the results on LVBench. We observed that reasoning dominated WorldMM’s median wall clock time (811s), as it used triple-extraction with VLMs across episodic, semantic, and visual memories. VideoLucy, on the other hand, was dominated by its multi-frame coarse-window captions (67%) as compared to reasoning. Our method optimized both frontiers, and neither captioning nor reasoning dominated, ensuring 2.9–8.3 × \times faster median wall clock time than the baselines.
blocks.zh: 接下来,我们将每种方法分解为三类:时间花在标题上,时间花在推理上,以及间接费用(例如视频解码,I/O等). 图4显示了LV Bench上的结果。 我们观察到,推理主宰了世界母亲运动的中位时钟时间(811s),因为它使用了与VLM的三层抽取,跨越了史诗、语义和视觉记忆。 而VideoLucy则以其多帧粗窗字幕(67%)与推理为主. 我们的方法优化了两个边框,没有标题或推理占据主导地位,确保2.9–8.3x\时间的中位时钟时间比基线要快。

blocks.en: We next characterized how LazySloth’s search behaves and what its behavior predicts about the final accuracy. Figure 5 plots the accuracy difference between LazySloth and direct inference against the depth the search reached. On Qwen3.6 27B, we noticed positive differences across all tested benchmarks, while on Gemma 4 31B, we noticed the differences were zero throughout. This was consistent with the model-based performance differences in Section 4 . Multi-level tree search did not impact Gemma 4 31B’s final accuracy, and likely negatively hurt its long video capabilities.
blocks.zh: 我们接下来描述LazySloth的搜索行为, 图5描绘了LazySloth和直接推论与搜索深度之间的准确性差异。 在Quen3.6 27B上,我们注意到所有测试基准的正差,而在Gemma 4 31B上,我们注意到差异是零的。 这符合第4节基于模型的业绩差异。 多层树搜索没有影响Gemma 4 31B的最终准确性,并可能对其长视频能力产生不利影响.

blocks.en: Next, Figure 6 analyzes the performance of LazySloth with respect to the caption budget during search on Qwen 3.6 27B. The first descent into the tree (moving from five caption calls to nine) clearly helped the VLM, as accuracy rose by 25%. Beyond that, accuracy fell on Video-MME, LongVideoBench, and LVBench. On EgoSchema, accuracy declined monotonically, likely as videos in the dataset were extremely short (three minutes each). This decline was largely correlated with harder questions, where the search failed to resolve the query cheaply in higher levels of the tree.
blocks.zh: 接下来,图6分析了LazySloth在Quen 3.6 27B搜索时在标题预算方面的表现. 第一次降入树下(从5个字幕调用到9个)显然帮助了VLM,因为精度上升了25%. 除此之外,精度也落在Video-MME,LongVideo Bench,和LV Bench上. 在EgoSchema上,精确度可能单调下降,因为数据集中的视频极短(每集3分钟). 这种下降在很大程度上与更困难的问题有关,因为搜索未能在树的更高水平上廉价地解决查询问题。

blocks.en: We additionally investigated LazySloth’s ability to find the exact span in the video that contains the answer to the query. Compared to randomly choosing similar-sized windows, Figure 7 shows each VLM significantly improved ( 1.8 − 2.1 × 1.8-2.1\times ) at identifying the correct window (Qwen3.6 27B n = 163 n=163 and Gemma 4 31B n = 171 n=171 ). However, while the choice was not arbitrary, the final window did not contain the actual span for 86 − 91 % 86-91\% of the questions, where the model still answered the question correctly.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步调查LazySloth在包含对询问的答案的视频中找到确切跨度的能力。 与随机选择类似大小的窗口相比,图7显示每个VLM在识别正确窗口时显著改进(1.8–2.1 × 1.8–2.1\times ) (Quen3.6 27B n = 163 n= 163,Gemma 4 31B n = 171 n= 171). 然而,虽然选择不是任意的,但最终窗口并没有包含86~91%86~91\%的问题的实际跨度,其中模型仍然正确回答了问题.

blocks.en: 4.3 Ablation Results
blocks.zh: 4.3 结果

blocks.en: We replaced VLM captioning with a frozen CLIP encoder, and found that accuracy fell by 8.8 8.8 – 19.9 19.9 % with CLIPScored nodes compared to a Qwen3.6 27B base model (Table 3 ). VLM-based scene understanding was a major contributor to LazySloth’s performance. Holding the scorer fixed at CLIPScore, the lazy top-down and eager bottom-up construction differed by at most 3.1 3.1 % with no consistent direction (Video-MME 41.5 41.5 vs. 43.4 43.4 , LongVideoBench 40.5 40.5 vs. 42.1 42.1 , EgoSchema 55.6 55.6 vs. 56.4 56.4 ). Lazy expansion largely did not affect accuracy, explaining how LazySloth speeds up video retrieval (Figure 3 ) without a massive performance loss.
blocks.zh: 我们用冷冻的CLIP编码器取代了VLM字幕,发现精确度下降8.8 8.8 – 19.9 19.9 % 与 Quen3.6 27B 基模(表3)相比,CLIPcored 节点下降。 基于VLM的场景理解是LazySloth表演的主要贡献. 拥有固定在CLIPScore的计分器,懒惰的自上而下和急躁的自下而上的构造最多有3.1%的差异,没有一致的方向(Video-MME 41.5 41.5 vs 43.4,LongVideo Bench 40.5 40.5 vs 42.1,EgoSchema 55.6 55.6 vs 56.4 56.4 ). 懒惰的扩展基本不影响准确性,解释了LazySloth如何加快视频检索(图3 ) , 没有巨大的性能损失.

blocks.en: Finally, we explored the effect of having a separate reasoner VLM in LazySloth, and found that the search trajectory largely determined the final answer (Table 4 ). The reasoner improved micro-averaged accuracy by 0.3 0.3 %, with no clear directionality. The searcher’s provisional answer was thus very nearly as accurate as the final one, and removing the reasoner’s VLM call could improve efficiency further.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们探索了在LazySloth中有一个单独的因子VLM的效果,发现搜索轨迹在很大程度上决定了最后的答案(表4). 原因使微平均精度提高了0.3%,没有明确的方向性. 因此,搜索者的临时答案与最后的答案几乎一样准确,删除原因的VLM呼叫可以进一步提高效率。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We introduce LazySloth, a tree-based search method for long-video understanding that bounds captioning to regions a VLM deems relevant rather than exhaustive captioning. Across four benchmarks and two open-source VLMs, LazySloth was 2.9 2.9 – 8.3 × 8.3\times faster than existing methods while matching or exceeding specialized video-understanding VLMs and RAG-based methods in accuracy. Detailed failure analysis showed gaps in VLM behavior where it navigated to the wrong window or degraded in performance with extra caption calls. Further, our ablations show LazySloth remained competitive due to VLM-based scene understanding, and lazy construction was close in accuracy with eager construction, thereby resulting in a method that speeds up long-video retrieval without a substantial cost in task performance.
blocks.zh: 我们引入LazySloth, 一种基于树的搜索方法, 用于长视频理解, 在四个基准和两个开源的VLM中,LazySloth是2.9 – 8.3 × 8.3\时速比现有方法快,同时精确地匹配或超过专门的视频理解VLM和RAG方法. 详细的故障分析显示VLM行为存在漏洞,它导航到错误的窗口或在性能上通过附加字幕调用而退化. 此外,由于基于VLM的场景理解,我们的模拟显示LazySloth仍然具有竞争力,懒惰的建筑精度也接近于急切的建筑,从而形成了一种在任务执行中无需花费大量费用的情况下加快长视频检索的方法.

blocks.en: 6 Limitations
blocks.zh: 6. 限制

blocks.en: One of the empirical shortcomings of LazySloth is that we observed our method assumed that long-video comprehension can be reliably localized to subtrees, as we observed poor backtracking and navigation to other branches. Our method also relied on the underlying caption quality generated across all resolutions, which we quantify in Appendix C . Additionally, our tests remain limited to two base models, without uncertainty quantification with multiple runs.
blocks.zh: LazySloth的经验性缺点之一是,我们观察了我们的方法,假设长视频理解可以可靠地本地化到亚树上,因为我们观察到反向跟踪和导航到其他分支的差. 我们的方法还依赖于所有决议所产生的基本标题质量,我们在附录C中量化了这些质量。 此外,我们的试验仍限于两个基本模型,没有以多重运行量化不确定性。

blocks.en: Because the captioner C C is held frozen across every method, we tested their sensitivity before committing to Nvidia’s Nemotron 3 Nano Omni. Table 6 shows that across six viable candidates, CLIPScore on frames randomly sampled from the six tested long-video datasets spanned only 0.2331 to 0.2447 CLIPScore, a range of roughly 5%. Importantly, only Gemma 4 E4B scored particularly worse at 0.2153. Since modern VLMs are capable of captioning images, this result is not quite surprising.

blocks.en: This brings us to the proposition of efficiency. To make LazySloth fast, we need C C to balance captioning quality with latency. Across the six candidates, we note that the per-caption latency spanned 0.59 to 2.70 seconds, demonstrating a difference of 4.6 × \times from the fastest to the slowest model. Since C C is invoked once per tree node and therefore sits in the inner loop of every method we compare, latency is the dimension that actually separates the candidates. Nemotron 3 Nano Omni was the fastest captioner that was not a quality outlier. Therefore, we chose this model for LazySloth and across all methods so that no baseline is advantaged or penalized. This allowed us to cleanly compare the merit of each retrieval method.

blocks.en: Appendix D Additional Efficiency Analysis of LazySloth
blocks.zh: 附录D LazySloth 效率分析

blocks.en: For a fine-grained understanding of the efficiency analysis in Section 4.1 , we broke down median inference time under each method and direct inference in Table 8 for the benchmark with the longest videos, LVBench. We found that inference time under each retrieval-based method grew linearly with video length, but the informative quantity is the slope of growth. While LazySloth paid 2.43 additional seconds per extra minute of video (s/min), VideoLucy paid 5.53s, and WorldMM paid 19.86s/min. We note that these differences were significant, as WorldMM paid 17.43 s/min more than LazySloth ( t = 13.2 t=13.2 , p < 10 − 39 p<10^{-39} ) and VideoLucy 3.10 s/min more ( t = 4.9 t=4.9 , p < 10 − 5 p<10^{-5} ). LazySloth therefore addressed the scaling problem that these methods struggled with.
blocks.zh: 对于第4.1节中的效率分析的精细理解,我们在每种方法下分解了中间推论时间,并在表8中直接推论了使用最长的视频LV Bench的基准. 我们发现,每种基于检索的方法下的推断时间随着视频长度的线性增长,但信息量是增长的坡度。 虽然LazySloth每额外一分钟的视频(s/min)额外支付2.43秒,但VideoLucy支付5.53秒,WorldMM支付19.86秒/min. 我们注意到,这些差异很大,因为世界母亲运动比LazySloth(t = 13.2 t = 13.2,p < 10 - 39 p < 10 >-39})和VideoLucy 3.10 s/min(t = 4.9 t=4.9,p < 10 - 5 p < 10 > 5})付出了17.43 s/min的会费。

blocks.en: This difference, however, stemmed from both the number of caption calls and how they were structured. As shown in Table 9 , LazySloth’s caption count was effectively compared to WorldMM and the brute-forced baseline, growing only from 35 on 40-minute-long videos to 45 under 140-minute-long videos due to the O ⁡ ( k ​ log k ​ N ) O(k\log_{k}N) bound of Equation (1). WorldMM grew from 97 to 330, and the brute-forced eager trees from 3,600 to 12,603, a factor of 280 at the longest videos. VideoLucy, however, is the interesting case as it issued 27 to 54 calls, statistically indistinguishable from ours, yet still ran roughly three × \times slower.
blocks.zh: 然而,这种差异来自字幕通话的次数和安排方式。 如表9所示,LazySloth的字幕数与世界MM和野蛮强力基线相比是有效的, WorldMM从97增长到330,野蛮的急切树木从3,600棵增长到12,603棵,在最长的视频中是280棵。 VideoLucy是27至54个电话的有趣案例,

blocks.en: This is because VideoLucy re-captions dense fixed-length overlapping windows, so each call carries more frames and more visual tokens than a LazySloth bunch caption. Figure 4 shows that captioning consumed 67% of its total time. Our bounded search cost precisely addressed this issue.
blocks.zh: 这是因为VideoLucy重现了密集的固定长度重叠窗口,所以每个调用都比LazySloth组合标题携带更多的帧和更多的视觉符号. 图4显示,字幕占总时间的67%。 我们设定的搜索费用正是为了解决这个问题。

blocks.en: To better understand the impact of tree depth searched by the searcher S S on final accuracy, we plotted the aggregate depth trend of Figure 5 by benchmark and backbone in Figure 10 . Direct inference has no search and therefore no depth of its own; it is scored on exactly the questions that fall in each of LazySloth’s strata. The decline we plotted in Figure 10 against Direct Inference indicated whether the deeper-searched strata are indeed the harder questions. This helps us eliminate an important confound that could misguide this discussion. The takeaway, therefore, is the performance difference between direct inference and LazySloth, which we plotted with 95% confidence interval bars.
blocks.zh: 为了更好地理解搜索者SS搜索树深对最终准确性的影响,我们在图10中按基准和主干线绘制了图5的总深度趋势。 直接推论没有搜索,因此没有其自身的深度;它正是在LazySloth的每个阶层的问题上得分的。 在图10中,我们对照直接推论所描绘的下降表明,更深层次的研究是否确实是更困难的问题。 这有助于我们消除一个可能误导本次讨论的重要混乱。 因此,取走是直接推论和LazySloth之间的性能差异,我们用95%的置信间隔条来规划。

blocks.en: We note that for Qwen3.6 27B, LazySloth consistently improved performance from direct inference, with the differences reaching statistical significance at higher tree depths across the four benchmarks, most sharply on EgoSchema and LongVideoBench.
blocks.zh: 我们注意到,就Quen3.6 27B而言,LazySloth从直接推论中不断提高性能,在跨越四个基准的树木深度较高时,差异在统计上具有重大意义,在EgoSchema和LongVideo Bench上最为明显。

blocks.en: On Gemma 4 31B, however, the two curves were essentially coincident on EgoSchema and LVBench, and LazySloth directionally improved performance on LongVideoBench, although not statistically significant. Since both the blue and orange lines in the plot refer to identical questions within each stratum, the difference cannot be attributed to question difficulty, and instead reflects how much a given base model gains from our method. Gemma 4 31B consistently struggled to gain any performance across the board, supporting our claim that gains are model-dependent, and Gemma 4 31B lacks any headroom to improve performance with retrieval-based or agentic frameworks.
blocks.zh: 然而在Gemma 4 31B上,两条曲线在EgoSchema和LV Bench上基本吻合,LazySloth在LongVideo Bench上的方向性提高了性能,虽然在统计学上并不重要. 由于剧情中的蓝线和橙线都指每个片段内相同的问题,所以区别不能归结为问题难度,而是反映了一个特定的基模型从我们的方法中获得了多少收益. Gemma 4 31B一直竭力争取获得任何全面的业绩,支持我们关于收益依赖模型的说法,Gemma 4 31B缺少任何以检索或代理框架改善业绩的机房.

blocks.en: Further, Figure 9 examines which branch the search descends into first against randomly picking any branch from the generated children. We note that models preferred the first frontier split consistently more than the other three branches, which have a roughly equal chance of being picked. The first descent landed in the opening quarter of the video on 49% of Video-MME and LongVideoBench questions, 54% of LVBench, and 64% of EgoSchema, which was roughly twice the random rate.
blocks.zh: 此外,图9还对照随机从所生子女中抽取任何分支的情况,对搜索的哪个分支进行首先审查。 我们注意到,模式倾向于第一个边界分化,这比其他三个分支分化一致,这三个分支基本上有同等机会被选中。 第一次降级是在视频的开场季度登陆了49%的Video-MME和LongVideo Bench问题,54%的LV Bench,以及64%的EgoSchema,这大约是随机率的两倍.

blocks.en: Finally, Table 10 matched LazySloth against direct inference on the same questions and split the result by the question type. We note that gains in performance were not uniform. Question types, mostly those requiring a moment to be located and then reasoned about, produced the largest improvements (LongVideoBench’s T2O gained 44.7%, SOS 38.3%, and TOS 37.0%, and Video-MME’s Information Synopsis and Temporal Reasoning gained 25.5% and 23.2% respectively). This is an architectural improvement LazySloth brings to the table. Types answerable from any representative frame, as expected, gained almost nothing. Our method helps the most in cases where finding the right moment is the task, which explains the performance differences reported in Table 2 .
